meta_description: Russell Gaunt Decorators in Leeds. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes. Professional finish, local craftsman.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right. From feature walls to full room makeovers, we deliver a finish that lasts.
services_subhead: Whether you're refreshing a single room or transforming your entire home, we handle interior decoration, exterior painting, wallpapering, and specialist finishes with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, and woodwork painted to a flawless finish. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality paints, and protect your furniture and floors throughout.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Weatherproofing
services.desc: Fascias, soffits, doors, and fence panels treated with weatherproof coatings that protect against Leeds' damp climate. Long-lasting colour and protection.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Pattern matching, paste application, and precision hanging. We work with traditional paper, vinyl, and feature wallpapers to transform any room.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create impact with bold colours or textured finishes. We help you choose the right palette and execute designs that make rooms stand out.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, architrave, and built-in furniture painted or stained to highlight the detail. Smooth, even coverage every time.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Proper prep is everything. We fill cracks, sand rough surfaces, strip old paper, and prime—so your new finish is durable and looks professional.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I believe good decoration should be reliable, honest, and built to last.
about_para_1: Russell Gaunt Decorators has been serving Leeds homeowners and businesses for over 15 years. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a respected local team, handling everything from small refresh jobs to large commercial projects. Every job is treated with the same care and attention to detail—because we know a well-decorated home matters.
about_para_2: We're known in Leeds for turning up on time, doing the work properly, and leaving your home cleaner than we found it. We don't cut corners on preparation, and we use quality materials that won't fade or peel. That's why our customers come back, and why they recommend us to their neighbours.

reviews.text: Russell came round, gave us a fair quote, and was true to his word on timing. Painted two bedrooms and the hallway. Brilliant attention to detail—you can barely see the joins where he's patched the walls. Top job.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had the lounge redecorated during lockdown and couldn't fault him. Brought his own dust sheets, cleaned up every day, and the finish is just perfect. Even quoted us for the kitchen next—we'll definitely be calling him back.
reviews.author: Helen W.

reviews.text: Turned up early, worked efficiently, and the exterior paintwork on our fence looks brand new. Charged a fair price and didn't oversell us any extras. Would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.author: David P.
